commands: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "5182086ed38f628bc7f7b7bba9687aaa761aeaf9"; echo '=== shellyRequests history ==='; git log --all --follow --oneline -- apps/mobile/src/flows/hardware-setup/shellyRequests.ts | head -40; echo '=== scanner function introduction/changes ==='; git log --all -S'scanShellySetupUrls' --oneline -- apps/mobile/src/flows/hardware-setup/shellyRequests.ts; echo '=== scan timeout changes ==='; git log --all -S'SHELLY_SETUP_SCAN_RPC_TIMEOUT_MS' --oneline -- apps/mobile/src/flows/hardware-setup/shellyRequests.ts; echo '=== stopAfterFirst changes ==='; git log --all -S'stopAfterFirst' --oneline -- apps/mobile/src/flows/hardware-setup/shellyRequests.ts; echo '=== current scan constants/function ==='; grep -n -A120 -B20 'SHELLY_SETUP_SCAN_CONCURRENCY\|scanShellySetupUrls' apps/mobile/src/flows/hardware-setup/shellyRequests.ts | head -220; echo '=== commits touching scan words ==='; for sha in $(git log --all --format='%H' -- apps/mobile/src/flows/hardware-setup/shellyRequests.ts | head -30); do msg=$(git log -1 --format='%s' $sha); if git show --format= --unified=2 $sha -- apps/mobile/src/flows/hardware-setup/shellyRequests.ts | grep -qiE 'scanShelly|SCAN_RPC_TIMEOUT|stopAfterFirst|concurrency|GetDeviceInfo'; then echo --- $sha $msg; git show --format= --unified=3 $sha -- apps/mobile/src/flows/hardware-setup/shellyRequests.ts | grep -E -C4 'scanShelly|SCAN_RPC_TIMEOUT|stopAfterFirst|concurrency|GetDeviceInfo' | head -120; fi; done
